findings.title: Shoppers can receive the previous person's preview after changing photos — replacing a selfie does not invalidate an in-flight generation
findings.observed: An earlier request can overwrite the new selfie with its old preview and look history.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot see selected boots on their generated model — the image prompt explicitly crops every portrait at the knees
findings.observed: A boots-equipped try-on requests a head-to-knees portrait, excluding the footwear.

findings.title: A malformed stylist response can blank a shopper's fitting room — model fields are returned and rendered without validating their types
findings.observed: A JSON object in style_note is passed to React and can crash the fitting-room render.

findings.title: The operator can incur uncontrolled model charges from anonymous traffic — both paid AI routes lack any rate, quota or abuse guard
findings.observed: No app-level paid-AI quota; external gateway limits could not be read.

findings.title: A long typed request can crash the fitting room and lose the shopper's session — FastAPI's validation-detail objects are inserted directly into a chat bubble
findings.observed: A message over 1000 characters returns a 422 detail array that React tries to render.

findings.title: Shoppers' private selfies and stylist conversations can be sent to analytics beyond the session — session replay is configured without masking the photo and chat surfaces
findings.observed: If provider replay is enabled, the page permits recording selfie image URLs and chat text.

findings.title: A shopper's new selfie can be replaced by the previous person's image when chat returns — assistant processing uses the selfie captured when the message was sent
findings.observed: A reply to an old chat request can generate a preview with the previous selfie.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot filter gear by minimum price — the catalog exposes only a maximum-price slider
findings.observed: No minimum-price control exists although the products API accepts min_price.

findings.title: Invalid or oversized uploads produce no useful selfie error — the file handler checks neither type nor size and does not catch image decoding failures
findings.observed: A non-image file fails downscale without a visible error; oversized files are accepted.

findings.title: Invalid selfie payloads can reach paid generation — try-on decodes any image bytes without checking the data-URL format or size
findings.observed: Raw base64 images and arbitrarily large image payloads pass the selfie check.

findings.title: Shoppers receive a successful preview missing selected gear — try-on silently drops unknown item IDs
findings.observed: Unknown item_ids are omitted and generation proceeds rather than returning an error.

findings.title: Marketplace integrators cannot copy a working embed URL — the Embed dialog only shows source-code fragments
findings.observed: Embed shows no URL or iframe snippet and no copy action.

findings.title: Budget shoppers cannot find a real black helmet under $50 — the only qualifying helmet-category item is a leather cowl
findings.observed: The black steel helmet costs $68; the $29 helmet-category result is a hooded cowl.

findings.title: A shopper's newer wardrobe choices are lost when the stylist replies — assistant changes are applied to the equipped-state snapshot from when the message was sent
findings.observed: Equipping another item while chat is pending is overwritten by the older wardrobe snapshot.

findings.title: Shoppers see results for an old filter after choosing a new one — completed product requests are not checked against the latest filter
findings.observed: An older, slower products response can overwrite a newer filtered grid.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot rely on the assistant's strict under-$50 filter — its returned maximum uses the catalog's inclusive price comparison
findings.observed: max_price=50 includes an item priced $50 even when the request says under $50.

findings.title: Shoppers can lose the preview and leave the camera active after closing the dialog — a late camera permission grant is not stopped on cleanup
findings.observed: If permission resolves after the dialog closes, the newly granted stream is never stopped.

findings.title: Shoppers can capture an empty selfie before the camera is ready — capture is enabled before video dimensions are available
findings.observed: Capture is enabled while videoWidth and videoHeight can both be zero.

findings.title: Shoppers see a false stylist success when the model supplies no answer — missing reply text is replaced with 'Done.' instead of an error
findings.observed: An empty model reply is returned as the successful assistant message 'Done.'.

findings.title: Shoppers can get unrelated gear for an unavailable request — the stylist is instructed to choose a closest match instead of returning no match
findings.observed: The prompt instructs the stylist to pick closest items when the request cannot be matched.

findings.title: Duplicate try-on requests can charge the operator twice — the anonymous generation endpoint has no idempotency or in-flight deduplication
findings.observed: Concurrent identical POST /tryon requests each issue a separate paid model call.

findings.title: Shoppers get an unhandled server error when a gear image fails or the model key is missing — setup occurs outside the provider error handlers
findings.observed: A product-image download error or missing model key bypasses the 502 error handler.

findings.title: Shoppers lose existing filters on a follow-up stylist request — assistant filters replace all controls rather than merging the returned changes
findings.observed: A stylist response with only max_price clears the existing category, color and search.

findings.title: Budget shoppers cannot select exact price limits — the maximum-price filter only allows $5 increments
findings.observed: The slider offers $20 or $25 but not a $22 maximum.

findings.title: Stylist recommendations can violate the shopper's color or budget — response cleanup checks only whether IDs exist, not whether they match the request
findings.observed: A valid but wrong-color or over-budget catalog ID is returned and equipped unchanged.

findings.title: Shoppers can see a broken preview instead of an error — generated image data is neither decoded and validated nor given a load-error fallback
findings.observed: A malformed provider image is returned as success and shown as a broken image.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot retake a camera selfie in the fitting room — the replacement control only opens file upload
findings.observed: After the first selfie, 'New photo' opens only the file picker, not the camera.

findings.title: Voice users can get out-of-order stylist replies and lost outfit changes — the microphone remains active while the assistant is thinking
findings.observed: A voice result can start a second chat request while an earlier request is pending.

findings.title: An empty wardrobe still generates added clothing on the shopper's model — the no-gear prompt prescribes a tunic and trousers
findings.observed: With no item_ids, the prompt adds a linen tunic and trousers.

findings.title: Shoppers cannot find later catalog items once the marketplace grows past 1000 products — all catalog and stylist reads are capped without pagination
findings.observed: Catalog, facet and stylist reads silently stop after the first 1000 products.

findings.title: Catalog and stylist requests slow as marketplace products accumulate — price-sorted reads need products(price ASC), while gender, color and aesthetic filters need their field before price
findings.observed: Catalog and stylist reads lack products(price ASC) and facet-plus-price indexes.

findings.title: Marketplace shoppers lose sight of equipped items in new categories — the wardrobe and checkout enumerate only eight hardcoded slots
findings.observed: An item in a new catalog category is equipped but absent from the tray and checkout.

findings.title: Shoppers lose the saved look they selected while a preview is generating — selecting history does not invalidate the pending generation
findings.observed: An earlier pending generation can replace a look selected from history.

findings.title: Timed-out AI requests can continue consuming server resources and provider credits after shoppers retry — model calls have no backend deadline
findings.observed: Browser timeout ends the wait but no backend deadline bounds the model call.

findings.title: Shoppers' stylist choices silently stop working after a temporary catalog error — the ID lookup is never retried even if the visible grid later loads
findings.observed: If the initial all-products request fails, later grid results cannot be equipped by chat.

findings.title: Shoppers lose catalog filter options after a temporary facets error — the initial request suppresses errors and has no retry
findings.observed: A failed facets request leaves category, gender, color and aesthetic options empty.

findings.title: Phone shoppers can lose the camera capture control in landscape — the centered camera dialog has no viewport height limit or scroll
findings.observed: A camera dialog taller than a short landscape viewport has no vertical scrolling.

findings.title: Shoppers without camera API support see a black camera instead of an upload instruction — the unavailable-API branch sets no error
findings.observed: Without navigator.mediaDevices, the camera stays black and Capture remains enabled.

findings.title: The microphone can remain active after the embedded fitting room is removed — speech recognition is not stopped on unmount
findings.observed: An active SpeechRecognition instance has no unmount cleanup that stops it.

findings.title: A visitor's very large selfie can stall other shoppers' requests — unrestricted image decoding and resizing block the server event loop
findings.observed: Unbounded selfie decoding and resizing run synchronously on the async server event loop.

findings.title: Shoppers with a full outfit can time out before image generation starts — product images are fetched serially with a separate 20-second timeout each
findings.observed: Eight uncached images can each wait 20s, exceeding the browser's 150s try-on timeout.

findings_minor.title: Catalog integrators cannot discover the lowest available price — the facets response omits its minimum
findings_minor.observed: /facets returns max_price but never returns min_price.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers cannot see the number of equipped items in the wardrobe — the tray never renders a count
findings_minor.observed: The wardrobe tray lists items but has no equipped-item count.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers see inconsistent price precision across the fitting room — item prices are rendered without two decimal places
findings_minor.observed: A $19 item displays as $19 while its outfit total displays $19.00.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers see template branding in the browser tab — the document keeps the starter title and description
findings_minor.observed: The browser tab is titled 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of the fitting room.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers see a blank catalog while products load — the loading flag suppresses the empty message but renders no progress indicator
findings_minor.observed: While the first products request is pending, the catalog grid is empty with no loading state.

findings_minor.title: Shoppers cannot use Reset after a zero-price stylist filter — the active-filter check treats zero as inactive
findings_minor.observed: An assistant-applied max_price of 0 filters the grid but hides Reset filters.

findings_minor.title: Visitors who open a mistyped fitting-room URL see a blank page — the router has no not-found route
findings_minor.observed: An unrecognized route matches no Route and renders an empty app body.

findings_minor.title: Keyboard users cannot compare their generated look with the original selfie — the compare button only handles pointer events
findings_minor.observed: Keyboard activation of 'Hold for original' has no key handler to reveal the selfie.

findings_minor.title: A pasted long URL can overflow the stylist chat on a phone — message bubbles do not break long words
findings_minor.observed: A long unbroken chat message has no word-breaking style and can overflow its bubble.

findings_minor.title: Voice users receive no explanation when microphone access or recognition fails — the speech error handler only resets state
findings_minor.observed: A denied microphone or recognition failure only clears the listening indicator.
